jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector

• You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

As a Recruitment Consultant, you will operate as a true 360° consultant, managing both client relationships and candidate processes. This role combines recruitment expertise with a strong commercial focus and offers the opportunity to develop your own market and portfol

Client Details

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.

As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Description

Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.

Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.
 

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

As a Bus Diagnostic Technician, you’ll help lead the transition to smart, electric passenger transport. You’ll work in a modern workshop where you track down, analyze, and solve technical faults on buses from various brands. From day one, you play a crucial role in getting our vehicles back on the road quickly and safely.

On a typical workday, you analyze malfunctions using diagnostic equipment, read error codes, and interpret electrical diagrams. You carry out mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs and maintain precise work administration. You support colleagues with complex problems, assist with roadside service during working hours, and continue to learn about new technologies such as electric drive systems.

Are you ready to further develop your technical expertise in a rapidly evolving sector? Apply today and discover a varied job where quality, teamwork, and innovation are key!

• Degree in automotive engineering, electromechanics, or equivalent through experience

• At least 2 years of experience as a diagnostic, bus, or truck technician

• Strong knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and electronics

• Experience with diagnostic equipment

• Valid driver's license B (D is a plus)

• Good command of Dutch or English

• Accurate, quality-oriented, and a real team player

• Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is a plus, but not required

• Technical mindset and eagerness to learn are essential

• Willingness for occasional roadside service during or outside working hours

• Service vehicle for business and private use (after 6 months)

• Diagnosing issues using STAR and MANCATS diagnostic systems
• Performing maintenance tasks on trucks
• Dismantling and/or removing certain parts
• Customizing for specific assignments
• Taking care of customer vehicles and ensuring customer satisfaction

• A higher education in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience
• Experience with diagnostic tools.
• Good English knowledge.
• Knowledge of general mechanics (or automotive mechanics), metalwork (welding), and basic electrical knowledge
• Team player but can also work independently
• Works accurately, are solution-oriented, and flexible to customer needs

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

Step into a rewarding role as a Lift Technician where your technical prowess will keep crucial lift systems running smoothly. You’ll be part of a dedicated team responsible for installation, maintenance, and repair services, ensuring safety and reliability. Your daily tasks will include troubleshooting, performing mechanical and electrical maintenance, and collaborating closely with clients and team members to deliver top-notch service. 

An average day will see you working independently on various customer sites, primarily within the province of Antwerp. You'll tackle a range of mechanical and electrical challenges, ensuring each lift is operating safely and efficiently. Your problem-solving skills will be put to good use as you diagnose issues and implement effective solutions.

If you’re ready to elevate your career in a role that offers both challenge and opportunity, apply today! Your journey towards becoming a key player in our technical team starts here.

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience
• Background in mechanical and/or electrical fields
• Valid Category B driving license
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and manage your schedule
• Good communication skills in English
• Flexible and responsible attitude

Are you ready to start your career as a Maintenance Technician in a dynamic and technology-driven environment? As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring the optimal performance of our client's advanced machinery.

On an average day, you'll troubleshoot machine malfunctions, perform preventive maintenance, and collaborate with machine setters and operators to enhance production processes. Your proactive efforts will contribute to improvements in quality, output, and safety.

If you're eager to embark on a fulfilling career, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable part of our team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

• Technical school degree

• Good level of English

• Flexibility, motivation, and a strong sense of responsibility

• Experience in pneumatics and hydraulics is a plus

• Problem-solving mindset

• Willingness to work shifts

• Diagnosing issues using STAR and MANCATS diagnostic systems
• Performing maintenance tasks on trucks
• Dismantling and/or removing certain parts
• Customizing for specific assignments
• Taking care of customer vehicles and ensuring customer satisfaction

• A higher education in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience
• Experience with diagnostic tools.
• Good English knowledge.
• Knowledge of general mechanics (or automotive mechanics), metalwork (welding), and basic electrical knowledge
• Team player but can also work independently
• Works accurately, are solution-oriented, and flexible to customer needs

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? As a Flat Roofing Worker, you'll be installing, repairing, and maintaining flat roof systems in various commercial and industrial settings. We are looking for committed individuals who take pride in their work and can ensure everything is in its right place.

On a typical day, you'll be working both independently and as part of a team, ensuring that each roofing project meets the highest standards of quality and safety. You'll install bitumen, EPDM, and other flat roof systems, insulate and waterproof roofs, and maintain existing roof structures. Safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to comply with all safety standards while working at heights.

If you're motivated and eager to grow with us, apply today! Your skills and dedication will be rewarded with excellent benefits and an opportunity to advance in your career.

• Communicative English

• Safety conscious and hands-on mentality

• Not afraid of heights

• Ability to work in various weather conditions

• Valid VCA certificate (Basic) or willingness to obtain it

• Driving license B

• Flexibility to work extra hours on busy days

• Experience as a roofer is a plus

• Construction-related education or equivalent experience

Responsibilities:

At this position, your tasks will be highly varied. One day you might be performing (preventive) maintenance on industrial compressors, while the next you could be conducting complex repairs on a generator. In short, you'll have plenty of technical challenges and day-to-day variety.

• Conduct maintenance and repairs on rental equipment such as diesel generators and compressors to ensure optimal performance and safety

• Perform scheduled inspections and preventive maintenance routines to guarantee fleet reliability

• Troubleshoot technical issues, including mechanical and electrical problems, on site or in the workshop

• Prepare equipment efficiently after use to ensure readiness for the next customer

• Document maintenance activities and communicate technical findings clearly to team members and clients

• At least 2/3 years as a workshop technician/ engineer
• Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or a related technical field
• Strong knowledge of diesel engines, compressors, and electrical systems, including reading electrical diagrams 
• Fluency in English, with excellent communication skills for technical discussions and documentation
• Proven problem solving skills, results oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently or in a team
• Flexibility regarding working hours and a proactive attitude toward continuous learning and development

As a Project Engineer E&I (m/f/x), you play a key role within the Automation and E&I team. You are responsible for the design, development, and follow-up of electrical and instrumentation aspects in the construction of advanced organic waste processing plants. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of technical experts on projects in the Noorderkempen region and potentially elsewhere, both nationally and internationally.

On an average day, you’ll be drafting diagrams, performing calculations, and preparing technical documents. You’ll check on-site cabling and hardware, troubleshoot issues, assist with plant startups, and optimize control programs. You analyze faults, support customers, and actively participate in discussions with colleagues, clients, and suppliers. You report directly to the Head of Automation and E&I.

Are you analytical, hands-on, and looking for a challenge in an innovative sector? Apply now and make an impact with your technical expertise in an organization focused on sustainability and growth.

• You hold at least a professional bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant technical field (industrial sciences or engineering).

• You have several years of relevant experience (minimum 2 years).

• You have strong knowledge of low-voltage techniques and preferably also medium voltage.

• Experience with Eplan is a plus.

• You have knowledge of PLC and/or SCADA programming (such as Siemens TIA Portal, PCS7).

• You are analytical, creative, accurate, and punctual.

• You communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.

• You are flexible, stress-resistant, and enjoy working to deadlines.

• You are both theoretically and practically minded, and are willing to roll up your sleeves.

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a CNC Turner/Programmer? This role places you at the heart of precision manufacturing, where you'll operate and program CNC turning machines using advanced Heidenhain and Siemens control systems. Your expertise will ensure the production of high-quality, custom-made spare parts for various industrial applications.

A typical day involves collaborating with a team of five skilled professionals, programming and operating CNC machines, and ensuring finished products meet rigorous quality standards. You'll also engage in measuring and inspecting workpieces and occasionally assist in hydraulic cylinder repairs. A clean, organized workspace is a must to maintain safety and efficiency.

If you're passionate about precision and innovation, apply today to join a team that values expertise and teamwork!

• Proven experience as a CNC Turner/Programmer

• Proficiency in Heidenhain and Siemens control systems

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

• Experience in custom machining and measuring techniques

• Good level of English

• Willingness to work in a day shift, starting at 07:00 or 08:00

This is a full-time role for an Inside Sales (ENG) who speaks English, based in Merchtem. 
 

You will be responsible for communicating with customers, handling orders, and coordinating with the warehouse team to ensure smooth and timely delivery of products.
 

Additionally, the Internal Sales Employee will prepare sales quotations, follow up on leads, and collaborate closely with the sales teams. The focus  for this position is the region of Eastern Europe and English-speaking markets.
 

Is this job, where you can use your communication skills and languages, for you? Apply now via this site!

 

• Ability to work independently as well as within a team. 

• You are fluent in English. 

• Proficiency in additional languages is considered an advantage. 

• Excellent communication and customer service skills.

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.
 

Tasks:
 

 
• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
 
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
 
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
 
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
 
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

As an Asset Management Engineer for civil and structural assets, you strengthen the asset team at an industrial production site in Hoboken. Your focus is to help shape, implement and continuously improve the asset management approach for buildings, structures and related civil assets.

You work on tactical asset planning, maintenance strategy and lifecycle management. You collect and structure operational remarks, technical findings and improvement opportunities, and translate them into concrete proposals and follow-up actions.

You operate in an engineering environment that supports production across the full lifecycle of technical projects, from feasibility and design to realization and start-up. As asset management maturity is still evolving, you help define and embed practical working methods in daily operations.

• Support the design, implementation and rollout of the asset management system for civil and building assets.
• Help organize processes, asset registers, hierarchies, criticality models, maintenance logic, KPIs and documentation workflows.
• Translate asset management principles such as ISO 55000, lifecycle thinking and risk-based decision-making into practical methods for an industrial environment.
• Develop tactical plans to improve the reliability, safety and service life of buildings and structural assets.
• Create and refine multi-year maintenance plans and monitor relevant performance indicators.
• Translate risks, degradation insights and operational improvement opportunities into maintenance strategies, improvement actions and project proposals.
• Investigate degradation, deficiencies and incidents to control and reduce structural risks.
• Perform root cause analyses for recurring technical problems and structural shortcomings.
• Interpret inspection data, trends, degradation curves and remaining-life evaluations.
• Apply criticality and risk analysis methods to prioritize interventions and lifecycle actions.
• Define preventive and mitigating measures and convert them into practical maintenance strategies.
• Prepare interventions to an execution-ready level, including scope, technical descriptions, permits, safety conditions, materials, contractor input and planning constraints.
• Transfer complete work packages to the work coordinator and use execution feedback to improve future plans and strategies.
• Translate identified measures into practical civil and structural improvement actions.
• Define scope, risks, planning and budget for smaller interventions on buildings and structures.
• Coordinate contractors and condition-monitoring partners during engineering and execution.
• Provide technical direction, quality follow-up and documentation support for assigned interventions.
• Prepare project scope documents and CAPEX/OPEX proposals when required.
• Support design, review and handover so assets are inspectable, maintainable and reliable.
• Safeguard compliance with applicable standards and regulations, including ISO 55000, SEVESO and Eurocode where relevant.
• Ensure accurate and high-quality asset data management in EAM and DMS systems.
This full-time position is based onsite in Hoboken, Belgium. Occasional homeworking may be possible with prior alignment and approval.

• You have hands-on experience in industrial asset management, with a clear focus on tactical asset planning, maintenance strategy, criticality-based decision-making and lifecycle management.
• You have experience with the implementation of an asset management system in an industrial environment.
• You hold a master's degree in engineering. A background in civil or construction engineering is an advantage, but engineers from other disciplines are also considered if they have grown into asset management and can demonstrate a strong civil/structural affinity.
• You bring solid civil / structural knowledge & experience. This is an essential requirement for the role.
• You can demonstrate a strong affinity with construction and civil engineering.
• You have working knowledge of ISO 55000, SEVESO and Eurocode.
• You are capable of analysing technical and inspection data and translating conclusions into practical maintenance strategies and improvement proposals.
• You have experience with or exposure to methodologies such as RBI data interpretation, RCA, criticality analysis, risk analysis, degradation analysis and remaining-life assessment, and you are motivated to further deepen your expertise.
• You have experience coordinating projects and collaborating with contractors, inspectors or other external partners.
• Experience in a mature industrial asset management environment is a plus.
• Experience with EAM systems, DMS platforms, inspection databases, spreadsheets used for degradation models or predictive analysis tools is an asset.
• Experience with industrial structures, corrosion issues, cracking, renovation works or smaller civil interventions is a plus.
• Experience with work preparation in an industrial maintenance or turnaround environment is an advantage.
• You take ownership, communicate clearly and work effectively with a broad range of stakeholders.
• You combine problem-solving skills, learning agility and the motivation to further specialize in asset management.
• You are fluent in English and Dutch, both spoken and written. Other languages are a plus.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager – Business Transformation & Customer Onboarding
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate strategic projects from initiation to delivery while managing complex business transformations.
• Manage key customer onboarding initiatives, acting as a bridge between customers and internal product teams.
• Build and maintain trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment of objectives.
• Drive project governance, including planning, reporting, risk management, and strategic decision-making.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams and ensure smooth collaboration across departments for efficient delivery.
• Gather, challenge, and validate business requirements while managing actions and dependencies.
• Support change management initiatives and proactively identify improvement opportunities within the project scope.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in Project Management or Program Management.
• You possess a Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, Economics, Management, or a related field.
• You bring experience working in rapidly evolving or scale-up organizational structures.
• You possess strong organizational and prioritization capabilities with a strategic, helicopter-view mindset.
• You're a diplomatic and assertive communicator with strong influencing and stakeholder management skills.
• You have a proactive, solution-oriented attitude and the ability to work independently.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in telecommunications, specifically with Broadband, Fiber, HFC, or FTTH.
• Previous experience with Product Management or Change Management.
• Knowledge of API-driven service environments.
• Knowledge of French.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Czech + Polish OR Lituanian - Multiple shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English + Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.
